config.s3.endpoint_help: Address of the managed RustFS service. It is set automatically and shown for reference only.
config.s3.details_help: Technical status data of the service in JSON format, for example for troubleshooting. Read-only.
config.s3.allow_read_help: The agent may list and download objects.
config.s3.allow_write_help: The agent may upload objects and overwrite existing ones.
config.s3.allow_delete_help: The agent may delete objects. Deleted objects cannot be recovered.
config.s3.location_bucket_help: Name of the bucket the permission applies to.
config.s3.location_prefixes_help: One prefix per line. With no entries nothing is allowed unless the whole bucket is selected.
